notes: s020 τάς takes the supplied his under rule 76's availability test: αὐτῷ is already spent on on him, which is the ACT parallel of rule 76's own laid his hand on him.

The supplied and before laying is the one contested unit. Rule 98 does not reach the seam because the flanking participles are not both rendered alike — the earlier pair is finite and this one stays participial — but marking it added remains defensible.
s022 αὐτῷ keeps on: the compound verb governs a bare dative and the ASV writes a verb word of its own (rule 106).
The ASV's textual note records only an inserted longer reading the projection does not carry, so rule 97 does not arise.
